==Description==
'''Retro Stained Temple''' is a nighttime [[Maps|map]] that takes place on a gilded forest. It is a version of [[Stained Temple]] stylized after old Roblox.

==Design & Path==
'''Retro Stained Temple''' takes place on a circular-shaped island in the middle of the void, with a temple on it. In the temple, there are many gilded cliffs around the map, one with a statue on top of it, and a few grey spawn points. The temple is surrounded by gilded pillars and grey cliffs.

The path starts at the green portal and ends at the red portal.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Retro Stained Temple}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*There are a lot of good ground spots on this map, as this map's path bends a lot.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] can be very useful because of its path, as it allows it to cover a portion of the path for most of its flight path.
*There are a lot of cliff spots on this map, making cliff towers very useful here.
**The cliff in the middle of the map allows cliffs towers to cover most of the path, making them even more useful.
*You can place towers behind the entrance, this spot is especially useful to the [[Shotgunner]] as it enables it to pierce enemies more effectively.

==Trivia==
*'''Retro Stained Temple''' is based on ''[https://www.roblox.com/games/45778683/Classic-Temple-of-the-Ninja-Masters Temple of the Ninja Master]'' made by Roblox.
